stem: The 12-month net revenue retention of Voltmarkt's Business Care subscription (a monthly device-support plan for small offices) is 112%. Which statement must be true?

options.text: No business in the starting cohort cancelled during the 12 months
The starting cohort pays more in total now than it did a year ago
Business Care has more subscribed businesses now than a year ago
Gross revenue retention for the same window is also above 100%
